elements.text: Reads Indian land records, validates them, scores its own confidence, and routes anything uncertain to a human.
A wrong khasra number is not a data error. It is a property dispute.
Decades of khatauni and 7/12 extracts sit in tehsil offices as paper.
Reading characters is the easy part

elements.text: The difficulty is knowing which field a value belongs to.
Text layer, then OCR, then degraded mode.
Page and reasoning, side by side
Each field carries a confidence bar and a one-click confirm. Clicking a value makes it editable, and trust recalculates on save. This record scored 94.
The system sorts its own output
elements.name: Slide title

elements.text: Seven blocked is the correct answer: three are degraded scans, the rest carry real defects.
Rules firing on the sample corpus
elements.name: Slide title

elements.text: Findings name the field and the rule, so a reviewer is told what to fix.
Confusions, aliases and confidence calibration are mined from human corrections. Rules activate only past a support threshold, so one typo never reshapes the model.
Access control and audit are enforced
elements.name: Slide title

elements.text: Operators upload and correct. Inspectors approve and reject. Officers retrain and export. The audit cell is read-only. An operator attempting approval gets a 403.
Ingestion, corrections with old and new value, approvals and rejections are written with actor and timestamp. Nothing can edit a past entry.
Reporting the department can act on
Volume, pending review, trust, district progress, error frequency and per-field quality. Precision reads 0.0% rather than an invented number, because only one field is reviewed so far.
Two decisions that make the demo survivable
elements.name: Slide title

elements.text: Zero install. Python standard library only, plus plain HTML and JavaScript. The biggest demo risk is a venue with no internet and a failing pip install.
Honest degraded mode. With no OCR engine, a scan is blocked with trust 0 and enters the queue as work, never as a silent success.
A running system, not a mockup.
Confidence is explainable, not a bare score.
